capabilities.name: v4.color.inspect
capabilities.description: Inspect one exact correction instance using the shared parameter tree and disclose uncalibrated named controls.
known_limitations: No live FCP acceptance; requires the integrated v4 core.
family is a requested logical namespace, not a verified native family classifier.
Native preview color space and tonemap are not measured.
No built-in name-to-channel-ID calibration; bind paths from this exact instance.

capabilities.name: v4.color.apply_adjustment
capabilities.description: Create a correction by its full catalog ID, or apply named typed values through instance-discovered paths.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client correlation; operation_id is the native durable idempotency key.

known_limitations: No live FCP acceptance; requires the integrated v4 core.
Creation and parameter writes are separate calls: inspect the newly created native instance first.
For adjustment calls target.effect_instance_id, time, bindings and adjustments are required.
Board/Wheels scalar or native-color and LUT string/mix/enum bindings only.
Curves/Hue-Sat point buffers, automatic LUT color-space mapping, and family calibration remain unsupported.
capabilities.atomicity: One core-owned native undo group; partial failure is reported, not automatically rolled back.

capabilities.name: v4.audio.inspect
capabilities.description: Read native gain, exact-time keyframe presence and source-channel enable/role state.
known_limitations: No live FCP acceptance; requires the integrated v4 core.
Audio stack identifier 0 only; no compound/component fallback.

capabilities.name: v4.audio.set_gain
capabilities.description: Set absolute dB gain as a constant or an exact-time native keyframe, with linear-gain readback.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client correlation; operation_id is the native durable idempotency key.

known_limitations: No live FCP acceptance; requires the integrated v4 core.
Constant writes reject any existing animation.
Native unit is linear amplitude, converted using 10^(dB/20).
Only audio identifier 0 is supported; other audio components are not silently selected.
capabilities.atomicity: One core-owned native undo group; partial failure is reported, not automatically rolled back.

capabilities.name: v4.audio.fade
capabilities.description: Set or remove one audio fade using a native float-duration setter and rational-time readback.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client correlation; operation_id is the native durable idempotency key.

known_limitations: No live FCP acceptance; requires the integrated v4 core.
Native default fade shape only; other fade-type enums are uncalibrated.
Native float precision and sample/frame quantization require live verification.
capabilities.atomicity: One core-owned native undo group; partial failure is reported, not automatically rolled back.

capabilities.name: v4.audio.effect.add
capabilities.description: Insert an exact catalog-verified audio effect and return its native instance identity.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client correlation; operation_id is the native durable idempotency key.

known_limitations: No live FCP acceptance; requires the integrated v4 core.
Full effect ID only; native stack placement needs live audio-component validation.
capabilities.atomicity: One core-owned native undo group; partial failure is reported, not automatically rolled back.

capabilities.name: v4.audio.effect.configure
capabilities.description: Configure EQ bands 1..8 or compressor controls through explicitly bound native parameter paths.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client correlation; operation_id is the native durable idempotency key.

known_limitations: No live FCP acceptance; requires the integrated v4 core.
Band/frequency/Q/gain and compressor names require explicit native path bindings.
No assumed Hz, dB, milliseconds, ratio scaling or enum ordinal.
capabilities.atomicity: One core-owned native undo group; partial failure is reported, not automatically rolled back.

capabilities.name: v4.audio.apply_preset
capabilities.description: Apply a caller-known native AU factory preset ID to one exact instance and read back presetID.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client correlation; operation_id is the native durable idempotency key.

known_limitations: No live FCP acceptance; requires the integrated v4 core.
Preset IDs must come from known native calibration; there is no preset catalog yet.
File presets and preset side-effect parameter diffs are not implemented.
capabilities.atomicity: One core-owned native undo group; partial failure is reported, not automatically rolled back.

capabilities.name: v4.audio.get_channel_map
capabilities.description: Read the existing native audio role UID and zero-based source-channel enable map.
known_limitations: No live FCP acceptance; requires the integrated v4 core.
Reports source enable flags, not a complete routing or stereo grouping model.

capabilities.name: v4.audio.set_channel_map
capabilities.description: Copy and replace the existing native source-channel enable map without changing routing or groups.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client correlation; operation_id is the native durable idempotency key.

known_limitations: No live FCP acceptance; requires the integrated v4 core.
One boolean per existing channel; no source-count, channel-routing or stereo-group changes.
Requires the clip to provide a native undo snapshot.
capabilities.atomicity: One core-owned native undo group; partial failure is reported, not automatically rolled back.

capabilities.name: v4.audio.set_role
capabilities.description: Assign an existing native audio role UID using the sequence action and verify the stored UID.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client correlation; operation_id is the native durable idempotency key.

known_limitations: No live FCP acceptance; requires the integrated v4 core.
Role must resolve in exactly one open library and match the current audio role native type.
No new roles, localized name selection or channel-specific subrole reassignment.
capabilities.atomicity: One core-owned native undo group; partial failure is reported, not automatically rolled back.

capabilities.name: v4.audio.ducking.plan
capabilities.description: Produce an explicit dialogue-driven ducking job specification without changing audio.
known_limitations: No live FCP acceptance; requires the integrated v4 core.
No native ducking or volume-keyframe generation is started.
Native sequence-support gate, dialogue activity detection and automation merge policy remain open.

capabilities.name: v4.retime.inspect
capabilities.description: Read native rate and segment count plus exact native source/component/timeline sample relations.
known_limitations: No live FCP acceptance; requires the integrated v4 core.
Samples are a relation, not a complete curve or unique source-to-timeline inverse.
Holds/reverse can have multiple timeline matches; custom point buffers are not exported.

capabilities.name: v4.retime.set
capabilities.description: Apply constant speed, a reverse toggle, exact-time freeze, or a to/from-zero native ramp.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client correlation; operation_id is the native durable idempotency key.

known_limitations: No live FCP acceptance; requires the integrated v4 core.
Reverse is one toggle; the core operation_id must be reused for reconciliation, never retried as a new operation.
Arbitrary piecewise curves, ramp falloff values and optical flow analysis are not supported.
Samples confirm native state, not rendered motion quality.
capabilities.atomicity: One core-owned native undo group; partial failure is reported, not automatically rolled back.

capabilities.name: v4.analysis.start
capabilities.description: Validate and record a blocked analysis admission. No native task is started by this version.
known_limitations: No live FCP acceptance; requires the integrated v4 core.
Always returns UNSUPPORTED_ANALYSIS_ADAPTER with native_started=false and ready=false.
No unverified options dictionaries, control points, enum values or cancellation selectors are executed.
Local admission records are process-scoped and capped at 256.
capabilities.atomicity: One core-owned native undo group; partial failure is reported, not automatically rolled back.

capabilities.name: v4.analysis.status
capabilities.description: Read a process-local analysis admission; blocked is never treated as completed.
known_limitations: No live FCP acceptance; requires the integrated v4 core.
No native object-tracker/mask/Smart Conform/stabilizer execution adapter is implemented.

capabilities.name: v4.analysis.cancel
capabilities.description: Cancel only a local blocked admission, without touching global native FCP tasks.
known_limitations: No live FCP acceptance; requires the integrated v4 core.
No native object-tracker/mask/Smart Conform/stabilizer execution adapter is implemented.

capabilities.name: v4.analysis.result
capabilities.description: Return ANALYSIS_NOT_READY; this version cannot produce a native analysis result.
known_limitations: No live FCP acceptance; requires the integrated v4 core.
No native object-tracker/mask/Smart Conform/stabilizer execution adapter is implemented.
